scenarios.description: getPayment_id() returns 0 on a newly constructed PaymentHistory object before any setter is called.
getPayment_id() returns a positive value after setPayment_id() is called with a positive integer.
getPayment_id() returns zero after setPayment_id(0) is called.
getPayment_id() returns Integer.MAX_VALUE after setPayment_id(Integer.MAX_VALUE) is called.
getPayment_id() returns Integer.MIN_VALUE after setPayment_id(Integer.MIN_VALUE) is called.
getPayment_id() returns a negative value after setPayment_id() is called with a negative integer.
getPayment_id() returns the value most recently set if setPayment_id() is called multiple times with different values.
getPayment_id() is not affected by changes to other fields (e.g., account_id set via setAccount_id()).
getPayment_id() returns independent values for separate PaymentHistory instances with different payment_id values.
getPayment_id() returns the same value on repeated calls without mutation.
getPayment_id() returns only the set payment_id even if the object is used with JPA annotations like @Id.
getPayment_id() returns the most recently set value when setPayment_id is called multiple times with different values.
getPayment_id() returns correct value for each instance after setPayment_id is called with different values on two Payment objects.
getPayment_id() returns the same value upon repeated calls without any intervening setter calls.
getPayment_id() return value is independent of setting account_id via setAccount_id.
getPayment_id() returns 0 for each instance when multiple Payment objects are constructed and no setter is called on either.
getPayment_id() correctly reflects a negative value when setPayment_id(-999) is called.
